Evidence: Office-to-residential conversion confirmed. Existing B use is inferred, not documented. IRC townhouse eligibility is not yet established.
Required_action_or_correction: Obtain existing occupancy record and classify the complete building; select IEBC compliance method with the Village.

Evidence: Architect confirms zoning/conversion approval. Approved drawings and conditions are absent.
Required_action_or_correction: Reconcile total units, bedroom mix, balconies, parking and building outline with the actual approval. Do not infer a new rezoning requirement.

Evidence: Existing sprinkler status is unknown. Architect reports complete interior-wall demolition; assess the local full-interior-renovation trigger.
Required_action_or_correction: Resolve local IFC 903.2 and residential R313 with Fire Prevention; document system type, water supply and coverage. No sprinkler exemption assumed.

Evidence: Shared wall lines have no tested assembly, continuity, roof junction or penetration detail.
Required_action_or_correction: Provide rated assembly schedule and coordinated sections. Confirm structural independence/accepted exceptions if IRC applies.

Evidence: Earlier concepts put sinks against shared walls without a defined service route. This did not prove piping was inside a rated cavity.
Required_action_or_correction: R03 reserves a separate 6 in zone on each kitchen side. Route services within each unit; engineer size, firestopping and floor penetrations.

Evidence: Ground-floor bath doors are close to the first tread. Clear landing and door geometry are not fully dimensioned.
Required_action_or_correction: Provide enlarged measured plans and sections. Reposition/rehinge only after fixture clearance and landing geometry are verified.

Evidence: Upper-floor stair lines overlap sanitary fixture graphics. A graphic conflict is visible; a physical conflict is unproven.
Required_action_or_correction: Separate floor-below linework and draw stair opening plus headroom section. Original Option 2 stays unchanged.

Evidence: Riser count, floor height, tread/landing dimensions and headroom cannot be reconciled from the supplied set.
Required_action_or_correction: Survey levels and draw each distinct stair section. Verify handrails, guards and all turning treads under the accepted code.

Evidence: Bedroom windows are shown, but net clear opening, sill height and operating type are not scheduled.
Required_action_or_correction: Check every bedroom. Balcony access alone does not establish a compliant rescue opening or exit route.

Evidence: Doors are drawn without a clear-opening or level schedule. External discharge to a public way is not documented.
Required_action_or_correction: Dimension clear openings, thresholds, landings and exterior routes; verify accessible entrance obligations.

Evidence: Option 3 access symbols are ambiguous. Option 5 proposed sliders clarify intent but do not resolve construction.
Required_action_or_correction: Option 5 specifies safety glazing. Resolve structural headers, guards, loads, drainage and thresholds before release.

Evidence: Earlier new glazing had no safety-glazing specification.
Required_action_or_correction: R03 specifies safety glazing at slider; check adjacent panels and the selected tested product. Keep appliance and door operation clear.

Evidence: No site access slopes, threshold levels, scoping matrix or accessible-unit details supplied.
Required_action_or_correction: Establish state and applicable IBC/IEBC scoping, unit counts and common-area obligations. Ground-floor bedroom alone is not proof of accessibility.

Evidence: Interior walls are already removed, per architect. Existing/new floor structure and stability of the retained exterior shell are undocumented.
Required_action_or_correction: Verify retained-shell stability, columns, beams, foundations and any new floor/stair openings. Include dead loads, alterations and balcony support.

Evidence: No wall/roof build-ups, window performance, air-sealing or compliance calculation supplied.
Required_action_or_correction: Prepare conversion-specific 2024 Illinois energy assessment and identify retained versus altered envelope elements.

Evidence: No coordinated residential HVAC, exhaust, fresh air, water/sewer or electrical capacity plan supplied.
Required_action_or_correction: Locate equipment and shafts, exhaust outdoors, maintain separation and coordinate laundry/kitchen/bath services.

Evidence: Architectural set does not show a coordinated alarm/detection plan.
Required_action_or_correction: Provide device layout, power/interconnection and system coordination under the accepted local/state code pathway.

Evidence: Selected source aisle dimensions are 36 in. Open appliance doors and chairs can reduce usable space.
Required_action_or_correction: Test actual equipment and occupied furniture. A 36 in kitchen aisle is not by itself a proven code violation.

Evidence: Units differ by row and corner. Complete room/opening chains and measured clearances are missing.
Required_action_or_correction: Dimension each unit separately; select real appliances and furniture. Retained source dimensions are not field verification.

Evidence: Laundry/service access, linen/general storage, entry coats and acoustic privacy are not consistently resolved.
Required_action_or_correction: Develop storage schedule and maintenance access; review sleeping-room privacy, daylight and demising-wall acoustics.
